content:
hana: spotted plaintext GCP SA id in staging partner webhook payloads. payload also included `wrapped_blob: partner-wrap:v7`. redacted snippet and opening SEC-5180.

omar: where in staging? paste safe grep (no secrets) and vault path.

hana: grep: logs-staging:/var/log/webhooks/partner/* found `service_account: partner-ingest@...` and `wrapped_blob: partner-wrap:v7`. vault path reading it is `secret/data/partners/ingest`.

infra: containment plan: pause consumer, snapshot vault metadata, ask partner to rotate/revoke, transit rewrap, short-lived RBAC lock. who can run the rewrap?

omar: I can run vault ops. steps (dry-run then apply):
``
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/partners/ingest > /tmp/partner.meta
vault transit rewrap -mount=transit partner-wrap-key partner-wrap:v7 --dry-run
vault transit rewrap -mount=transit partner-wrap-key partner-wrap:v7
```
I'll also enable request/response audit if needed and drop logs to SEC-5180.

vault-bot: audit: request/response logging confirmed on secret/data/partners at 2026-10-11T12:34:00Z.

hana: paused webhook-ingest-staging and pinged partner; asked for proof of rotation within 30m.

omar: dry-run ok, performing rewrap -> new ciphertext partner-wrap:v8. updated KV to reference v8 and redeployed consumer. QA verifies decrypts fine.

infra: applying emergency Vault policy to restrict writes to `secret/data/partners/*` except platform-ops during containment window.

sec-bot: alert: SEC-5180 updated, containment in progress.

hana: infra, rotate any internal staging SA keys that accepted the webhook and add ingestion IP allowlist while partner rotates.

infra: started internal key rotation and IP allowlist push. ETA 25m.

hana: follow-ups: 1) add presubmit payload linter for SA key patterns (devex) 2) tighten partner onboarding docs 3) schedule RBAC audit for partner identities. leaving SEC-5180 open until partner confirms rotation and we finish internal rotations. :lock:
